title: So Sai Tan
desc: Javed Akhtar explains that pursuit of happiness ends within us. One doesn't have to look for it outside, one just needs to clear their mind of all fears and worries, and that is true happiness.

title: Mann Maila Tann
desc: Javed Akhtar says it hurts most when a trustworthy person; one from the inner circle betrays you compared to somebody who is expected to deceive you. The latter may make you angry but will not hurt you.

title: Ati Ka Bhala
desc: Mahakavi Ghagh's Doha about abundance and extremities is translated into real life lessons by Javed Akhtar. He says balance is the core of life and anything in extreme is going to create a disruption.

title: Peeya Chahe Prem
desc: Javed Akhtar explains that love and ego are like two swords. One cannot expect the two swords to be kept in same case. To embrace pure love, one must let go of their ego.

title: Sabal Na Pust
desc: Javed Akhtar explains that one needs to put his/her point forth amicably and not by using physical strength or force. As the latter will be a temporary solution while the former is a permanent fix.

title: Kathni Meethi Khand
desc: If you promise someone something it is very important to act on it, Javed Akhtar takes you through some examples of this from real life in this episode.
